text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! Now, for the results!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
What, you ask? The fan votes for the
Arima Kinen
are about to be announced
on TV, dear Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
My goal... is to break through to the top
by a
landslide!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I can ill afford to fall behind the
generation of
yore in any facet,
including popularity.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: I-I'm sure you did great, Opera O...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото is here to watch as well.
The results
are about to be revealed...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Next up, the votes for Т.М. Опера О.
text_block_list.name: Host

text_block_list.text: Da-dum-da-dum-da-da-da!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Т.М. Опера О's total comes out to...
text_block_list.name: Host

text_block_list.text:
93,217 votes! Her spot in the Arima
Kinen is
secured!
text_block_list.name: Host

text_block_list.text: Oh... Oh... Ooohhh!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I've done it... I've done it! Haaah hah
hah!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I should share my elation with all my
adoring
subjects!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Aaah ha ha hah!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Ayabe! Ha ha ha, I say!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
What the?! Would you stay out of my
room,
please?
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
After running around in an explosion of
joy...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Trainer, call a press conference.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious? To announce my
readiness to run
in the Arima Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I get a space prepared to hold the press

conference.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Trainer... While I highly doubt it, you
don't
believe I'm setting myself up for
disappointment,
do you?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I know it's hard to believe. Suddenly,
though, I'm
remembering what
happened after my debut race.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I had full confidence in my prominence
at the
time, but only a single reporter
bothered to
attend.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Oh yeah... It was so nice and quiet.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: No, Doto. That was not my intent!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The thought comes to me every now and
then.
Maybe all this glory I see... is
merely a
fancy—something dreamt up by
a king in the
midst of summer.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps this dream will become a
nightmare once
I open that door... to a
barren, empty hall.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Ngh... How unlike me—to become frozen
and
fearful of my dreams...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: Should I... open the door for you?

text_block_list.text:
No, I shall do it. After all, I wish for you
to always
see me in a dignified light.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Expel the nightmare! How could all the
glory and
admiration I've received be a
mere dream?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Now, let the gates open!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Creeeak!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Reporters

text_block_list.text: Hyeeeee!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Her fears turn out to be unfounded. The

conference room is filled with people,
people,
and more people.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Reporters with nothing but praise for
T.M. Opera
O are packed into the room
like sardines.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Heh, hehehe... How wondrous I feel.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
She would usually be cackling about
now. But in a
rare turn of events, she
simply chuckles.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Looking back, there was only one
reporter at my
first conference, and my
dinner show failed to
attract anyone.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
But gaze upon this now. See how many
people
have come, all for me.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on qualifying for the
Grand Prix,
Opera O!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
You're looking as good as ever! Say
something to
your fans!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр B

text_block_list.text: This... This is what I've been pursuing.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Sniffle How... unbecoming... for the Overlord to shed tears.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The turnout must be deeply moving for
her. She
appears incredibly happy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Opera O, would you like more eye
drops?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Of course! With haste, Doto.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: ...All an act.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Good evening to you all. And thank you
for
taking the time to gather at this
event.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I've summoned you here so that I might
express
the extent of my feelings on the
overwhelming
support I've received from
my fan base.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: It will be in the form of a four-part, eight-hour epic entitled, The Tale of Opera O: Fury Upon Nakayama!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Ughhh...
text_block_list.name: Reporters

text_block_list.text:
Unsurprisingly, that has the reporters
groaning,
but it seems the press
conference is a big hit
nonetheless.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. A great deal of time
has
passed since my debut...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
But I've only come this far due to your
support.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: So... I believe a small gift is in order.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, it's not yet ready. I shall
present it
to you in half a month's time.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
It will be the ultimate euphoria—victory
at the
Arima Kinen, as well as the throne
of greatest
trainer.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
My efforts will grant you these gifts. So,
will you
wait for me... at that special
place?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The throne—the Centurial Overlord's
throne, to
be specific.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The winners' circle at the Arima Kinen...
That is
the special place where I shall
receive my crown!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
